teaser: 44 legal companies scored on who does the work, who stands behind it, and whether an agent can hire them.
core_idea: A map of companies selling legal work done with AI, built with a method fixed before scoring and a formula anyone can re-run, from public evidence only, with every score's URL and quote and the page captures in a public vault. Automation, accountability and agentic readiness are scored from fourteen indicators. Garfield.Law and Crosby combine AI doing the work with a lawyer standing behind it; Soxton, LegalZoom and Rocket Lawyer can be used by an agent; none has both, which is where the newsroom's proposal of legal on demand sits as a target.
